name: Voria Cafe (Sardar Jangal)

location.address: Sardar Jangal Blvd, corner of Qods-e Gharbi, South Punak, Tehran

media.alt: Interior of Voria Cafe on Sardar Jangal Boulevard

description: One of west Tehran's most-followed cafe chains, with a dedicated Sardar Jangal branch in South Punak. Reliable coffee and full menu in a polished, modern space. Popular enough to draw a steady crowd most evenings.
